messages:
alex: quick note 1: planning a kernel+quant bundle swap tonight in the quiet window. minimal outage target, but we expect a short quiesce.
maria: what time window?
alex: 01:30-01:50 UTC. quiesce 5m, swap 10m, validation 10m. region order: eu -> na -> ap.
jamie: define rollback gates so ops can act fast.
alex: rollback if p95 > 2x baseline for 3 consecutive minutes OR error_rate > 1% sustained for 5m OR smoke-set mismatch >0.4%. pin TTL=1h on rollback.
sam: deploy-bot, schedule with surge_protection and preflight slice=3%. add annotation: owners=jamie,maria,sam.
deploy-bot: @alex scheduled deployment 4479998888 for 01:30 UTC. surge_protection=on. preflight will run against canonical_smoke set at 3% traffic.
sre-oncall: I'll stand by. post traces to #eng-sre if anything funky.
maria: release notes blurb draft: "runtime: engine kernel v7.3 + quant v4.4 — KV cache fixes, batching improvements. Partial regional rollout planned." add link to changelog after deploy.
jamie: include manual pin route in notes: /v1/runtime/pin. ops will need it if rollback.
alex: metrics to watch: token p50/p95, tail p99, kv-cache evictions, quant-compat failures. dash: https://dash.internal/runtime/deploys/4479998888
sam: preflight command for staging: ```bash
./preflight.sh --smoke canonical_prompts --slice 3 --timeout 600
```
deploy-bot: preflight started. logs will be posted here.
deploy-bot: preflight passed. smoke regressions=0, kv_eviction=0.15%, latency within baseline.
maria: proceed with region eu. keep 5m bake.
deploy-bot: starting eu swap (1/3) at 01:31 UTC. quiesce=true.
deploy-bot: eu swap complete. smoke checks ok. bake 5m.
sre-oncall: eu traces look clean. continuing to na.
deploy-bot: starting na swap (2/3) at 01:39 UTC.
deploy-bot: na cluster g-21 reported 1.9x p95 spike for 2m. auto-throttle engaged and traffic shifted to fallback variant.
alex: seeing the spike. can we isolate to a driver variant?
jamie: capture kernel logs and kvcache stats now: /var/log/runtime/kernel-swap.log and /var/telemetry/kvcache.csv
sam: grabbing flamegraphs and qperf traces. starting incident thread.
deploy-bot: na region pinned to previous bundle (pin ttl=3600) after throttle. ap swap halted.
maria: marking ap aborted and updating release notes: "na roll backed, ap postponed; investigation ongoing."
sre-oncall: initial hint: a mismatch between quant kernel symbol layout and driver 520.4 variant on a subset of hosts. we'll reproduce in lab.
alex: thanks team. surge protection and throttle did their job. we'll rebuild quant with kernel shim targeting driver-520.4 and re-run preflight tomorrow.
jamie: follow-ups: 1) reproduce with driver-520.4, 2) add per-kernel-signature telemetry, 3) make canary throttle stricter for next run.
maria: I'll update changelog and include incident link.
sam: reopening deploy ticket and scheduling rebuild. leaving quiesce lifted. :thumbsup:
